subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Should maintainers authorize a fresh same-repository Feishu URL-boundary fix, or adopt one of the conflicting fork PRs for this issue?
rationale: The bug is narrow and valid, but existing no-new-fix-pr state plus conflicting external fork candidates makes another automatic duplicate branch the wrong next step without maintainer direction.

options.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
options.body: Queue one narrow Feishu plugin fix with tests and real Feishu proof, using the closed and fork PRs as source context only.

options.title: Refresh a fork candidate
options.body: Pick one fork PR to adopt, resolve conflicts, and require focused regression coverage plus real Feishu proof before merge.

options.title: Wait for contributor follow-up
options.body: Keep this issue open without new automation until a contributor updates a candidate branch with mergeable code and proof.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a fresh same-repository fix
recommendation.body: Queue one narrow Feishu plugin fix with tests and real Feishu proof, using the closed and fork PRs as source context only.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu send-path maintenance makes this the strongest available owner signal for choosing the repair path.
